what: THE ANDROID LANGUAGE-GROUP MAP (Session 41, 30 Aug 2026). iOS delivers each language as its own On-Demand Resource (tag lang-<code>); Play Asset Delivery caps an app at 50 asset packs, so at 200+ languages Android cannot carry one pack per language. Languages are GROUPED (script first, region to subdivide the large scripts) into stable, reserved on-demand packs. A reader downloads only their group. This map is the authority the Android build reads to emit one asset pack per non-empty group, and the plugin reads at runtime to resolve a language code to the pack that holds it.
note: RULING settled (the author, 30 Aug 2026): grouped packs, not one-pack-per-language and not one-giant-languages-pack. Pack names are STABLE — never rename a pack once shipped (a rename is a full re-download for every existing user); add languages into existing groups, and add new groups only for a script/region the map does not yet cover. `en` is the source, inlined in the base module, and is NEVER a pack. Verification stays PER-LANGUAGE against www/lang-manifest.json (§14) — a group pack merely bundles several lang-<code>.json files. Session 45 (8 Sep 2026): the 63 languages added since 30 Aug placed into the existing groups by script (assign_rule.by_script); no group renamed, no new group needed (ethiopic stays empty until an Ethiopic-script language joins the roster). Session 50 (23 Sep 2026): reconciled to the 105-edition roster — 232 non-rostered codes (the old 200+ NLLB/MADLAD superset) pruned from the groups, and the six Sept-18 Claude-beta editions the roster had gained but this map never placed added by region: fj/mi/sm/tpi -> latin-oceania (now non-empty), lg/rn -> latin-africa. Android had not shipped since Session 44, so the map had drifted; lang_groups.py check and ship_android step 3 were failing until this pass. No group renamed.

cap.note: Google Play Asset Delivery limits (verified 30 Aug 2026). The corpus is its own on-demand pack besides these language groups; count it against the 50.

other-scripts.script: Minority scripts (Tibetan, Cherokee, Canadian syllabics, Thaana, Syriac, Tifinagh, …)

assign_rule.note: How a NEW language is placed, so additions rarely need a new group. The map's `langs` lists are authoritative; this is the rule that fills them. tools/lang_groups.py enforces that every roster language (except `base`) lands in exactly one group.

by_script.Latin: subdivide by region: latin-euro-west | latin-euro-north | latin-euro-central | latin-baltic | latin-turkic | latin-africa | latin-sea | latin-americas
by_script.Cyrillic: cyrillic (split to cyrillic-2 only if the group nears the per-pack byte cap)
by_script.Arabic: arabic (fa, ur, ps, ckb ride here — Arabic script, not their region)

assign_rule.overflow: If any group's total bytes approaches maxOnDemandPackBytes (512 MB), split it (e.g. cyrillic -> cyrillic, cyrillic-2) and reserve the new name; never let a group exceed the per-pack cap. Total group count + 1 (the corpus pack) must stay <= maxPacksPerApp (50).
